summary: Buf16::partial_divide_96 increments a u32 remainder while propagating a carry. When the remainder is u32::MAX, plain addition panics with overflow checks enabled. wrapping_add(1) preserves the modular arithmetic required by the division algorithm. The regression test added by this fix checks that -79228157791897.854723898738431 / 184512476.73336922111 returns -429391.87200000000002327170816. The candidate's description of a u64 remainder in 64-bit division is inaccurate; the changed code uses u32 in 96-bit division. No tests were executed.
